title: LLM rerank confidence gate
prompt: Issue #95: skip the LLM rerank call when pre-rerank RRF top-K margin is unambiguous. Add the IRONMEM_RERANK_CONFIDENCE_MARGIN tunable, gate rerank before the LLM call, and prove before/after rerank-call counts once the baseline gate is satisfied.
acceptance: unit tests cover ambiguous vs unambiguous score vectors
integration test asserts no llm_rerank token_usage row when the confidence gate skips the call
existing search-quality benchmark remains unchanged

title: Pref-extract batching
prompt: Issue #96: batch preference extraction so add_drawer can group IRONMEM_PREF_EXTRACT_BATCH=15 items per prompt, parse multi-item structured output, and fall back to single-item calls on malformed batch output.
acceptance: mock client covers batched success and malformed response fallback
call-count reduction is asserted in token_usage
cargo test --workspace passes

title: A/B analysis and results thesis artifact
prompt: Issue #98: after #97 is merged and cost-approved runs are complete, write the A/B analysis/results artifact with confidence-qualified deltas for tokens-to-done, rework loops, and merged-rate per arm. Claims must use measured tokens only and respect the Goodhart guards in METRICS_SPEC.
acceptance: results section reports confidence-qualified deltas
headline numbers use measured tokens only, not estimated rows

title: Fix metrics capture baseline data path
prompt: Issue #113: metrics capture is wired but normal operation produces zero usable measured baseline data. Decouple occupancy sampling from the MCP access-mode gate, pass transcript_path for session-start sampling, and decide/document whether llm_rerank and pref_extract are enabled for dogfooding baseline rows.
acceptance: occupancy_samples receives rows from real hook paths
session_summary has non-zero token or occupancy fields when transcripts are present
ironmem report shows the measured split when measured rows are enabled

title: Exclude collab-plans from default recall
prompt: PR #116 follow-up: plan-by-reference stores accepted plans as collab-plans drawers with zero embeddings, but generic FTS recall can still surface their bodies. Exclude collab-plans from default recall while preserving explicit room=collab-plans lookup.
acceptance: default search excludes collab-plans drawer content
explicit room=collab-plans search still returns plan drawers
regression test covers both default and explicit-room behavior

title: Persist actor generation tracking across process restart
prompt: PR #117 follow-up: the generation lease uses a process-local active_collab_generations cache to make stale predecessors inert. Replace that process-local source of truth with persistent actor-generation tracking backed by collab_actor_generations so restart behavior is explicit and testable.
acceptance: actor generation checks survive MCP process restart
collab_actor_generations is the authoritative generation source
tests cover stale predecessor rejection after restart

title: Automate incremental code-map refresh for stale maps
prompt: Issue #94 follow-up: code_map_load reports Stale with changed_files, but workers still have to manually re-read those files and call code_map_write. Add a helper path that automates incremental refresh from changed_files without full repo re-scouting.
acceptance: Stale code-map verdict can trigger an automated refresh helper
only changed_files are re-read for incremental refresh
tests distinguish incremental refresh from full rescan

acceptance: source and all collab docs agree on 0.60/0.80 threshold values
handoff trigger and successor/cron fallback semantics match across docs
cargo test --workspace passes
